They are developed and maintained by Duncan Gates, please reach out with any concerns." image: "Images/cards/dashboards.jpg" listing: - id: dashboard_list contents: dashboard sort: "order" type: grid categories: true image-align: 'right' image-height: '100%' grid-columns: 3 - id: dashboard2_list contents: dashboard2 sort: "order" type: grid categories: true image-align: 'right' image-height: '100%' grid-columns: 3 - id: dashboard3_list contents: dashboard3 sort: "order" type: grid categories: true image-align: 'right' image-height: '100%' grid-columns: 3 - id: dashboard4_list contents: dashboard4 sort: "order" type: grid categories: true image-align: 'right' image-height: '100%' grid-columns: 4 - id: dashboard5_list contents: dashboard5 sort: "order" type: grid categories: true image-align: 'right' image-height: '100%' grid-columns: 3 format: html: page-layout: full engine: knitr --- ::: {.cell} ::: ## Participant Perceptions Participant perceptions include data from the end of session survey administered at the end of each PL session, end of course survey administered at the end of each PL course, ongoing coaching survey administered at the end of each coaching session, and end of coaching data, administered at the end of every coaching series. Lastly, NPS data is also prompted in this survey. ::: {#dashboard_list} ::: ## Participant Mindsets Participant mindsets come from the diagnostic educator survey and follow up educator survey. ::: {#dashboard2_list} ::: ## Participant Knowledge Participants that completed learning assessments will answer multiple choice quiz questions that address pedagogical content knowledge. ::: {#dashboard3_list} ::: ## Participant Practices Teaching Lab staff conduct classroom observations and capture standards and shifts aligned instruction in the classroom observations survey. Those results will appear in the following dashboards. ::: {#dashboard4_list} ::: ## Student Learning Experiences Respondents to the student survey and submissions of student work samples have their responses rolled up and graded in the following dashboards. ::: {#dashboard5_list} :::
